Home / Solutions / Customer Portals

Customer Portal Development for Self-Service Customers.

We build secure customer portals that give your customers self-service access to accounts, documents, support and payments, reducing routine requests for your team.

Let's Talk What we deliver
Overview

Every routine call or email, such as "where is my order?", "can you resend that invoice?" or "what is my balance?", is a question a customer could answer themselves if they had the right tool. A customer portal gives them that tool. We build secure portals around the tasks your customers do most, connected to the systems that hold the answers.

Customer experience

Better service with less effort

  • Self-Service access

    Allow customers to access services, documents and account information anytime.

  • Reduce support load

    Minimize support requests with easy access to information and resources.

  • Increase engagement

    Keep customers connected through updates, notifications and personalized experiences.

Portal features

Everything customers need in one place

  1. 01

    Account dashboard

    A personalised view of each customer's account, orders, services and recent activity.

  2. 02

    Document centre

    Secure access to invoices, contracts, statements and other files, available whenever they're needed.

  3. 03

    Support requests

    Customers raise and track tickets online, with full history and status updates.

  4. 04

    Online payments

    Customers view balances and pay invoices securely through the portal.

Is this right for you?

When this is a good fit

  • Your team answers the same questions daily

    Order status, invoices and account details take up support time.

  • Customers want 24-hour access

    They need information outside your office hours.

  • Documents are sent by email

    Invoices and statements are hard for customers to find later.

  • You want a more professional experience

    A branded portal would strengthen customer relationships.

Development process

How we build customer portals

We design portals around your customers' most common tasks and connect them to your existing systems.

  1. 01

    Requirement analysis

    Understand customer journeys, portal objectives, access requirements and business workflows.

  2. 02

    UX & portal design

    Design clear, accessible interfaces around the tasks customers do most.

  3. 03

    Development & integration

    Build secure portals and integrate with CRM, ERP, payment systems and business applications.

  4. 04

    Deploy securely, monitor performance and provide continuous enhancements and technical support.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can the portal show data from our existing systems?

Yes. We connect the portal to your CRM, ERP, billing or support systems so customers see live, accurate information.

How do customers sign in securely?

We use secure authentication, with options such as one-time passcodes and single sign-on, plus role-based access for business customers with several users.

Can customers pay through the portal?

Yes. We integrate payment gateways so customers can pay invoices and balances online.

Can the portal match our brand?

Yes. The portal is designed around your brand, with your logo, colours and tone.

Ready to build your customer portal?

Tell us what your customers ask for most often. We'll suggest which features to start with.
